signals.name: Washout during two-node opposite-complex outflow
signals.mechanism: washout_w>0 while >=2 opposite-complex nodes have recent onset outflow, pairing local capitulation with broader displacement away from another complex.

signals.name: Washout with dollar relief
signals.mechanism: Weekly washout (washout_w>0) coincides with the dollar's 10-day change turning down (dollar_chg_10d crosses below 0) while relative strength is not yet broken (rs>-0.04): buys a pressure-release reversion in globally-sensitive sectors as the dollar headwind relents.

signals.name: Same-complex outflow after credit stress eases
signals.mechanism: A same-complex onset outflow (forced selling) coincides with high-yield credit spreads ceasing to widen (hy_oas_chg_10d crosses below 0) while StochRSI K is still sub-60: buys the reversion once macro credit pressure stops accelerating.

signals.name: V-bottom: acceleration repair from extreme with oscillator oversold
signals.mechanism: Trend acceleration repairs from a statistical extreme (accel_z crosses above -2) while StochRSI K remains oversold (<30): the second derivative heals before price momentum turns, catching a V-bottom without relying on washout or outflow (a mechanism distinct from the washout family).

signals.name: Dual cross-asset relief with oscillator oversold
signals.mechanism: Dual cross-asset relief while the sector oscillator is still oversold: the dollar's 10-day change turns down (dollar_chg_10d crosses below 0) AND long bonds rally (tlt_ret_10d>0, i.e. rates falling) with StochRSI K<25. Both macro headwinds relent at once as the sector sits at an oscillator extreme. NOTE: ~67% entry-overlap with B4_WASHOUT_DOLLAR_RELIEF (shared dollar-relief root) — a correlated member of the dollar-relief cluster, additive via the ~33% non-washout entries, not an independent signal.

signals.name: V-bottom: accel repair from moderate extreme, deep oversold
signals.mechanism: V-bottom sibling of R16: trend acceleration repairs from a moderate extreme (accel_z crosses above -1.5) while StochRSI K is DEEPLY oversold (<20, vs R16's <30). The deeper oscillator gate offsets the looser accel threshold, selecting the highest-conviction oversold entries in the V-bottom family. ~42% entry-overlap with R16, ~46% novel entries: an additive sibling, not a subset.

signals.name: Oil-cost relief with oscillator oversold in stress
signals.mechanism: Oil-cost relief in a stressed, oversold sector: oil's 10-day return crosses from positive to negative (cost pressure reversing, relieving for cost-sensitive industrials/transports/consumers) while StochRSI K<30 (oversold) and VIX at/above the 40th pctile (stress context). The mild VIX>=0.40 gate is the design win — it lifts asym over the 1.5 floor while keeping n large. First oil-channel signal in the base; ~79% novel entries (max 14.1% overlap with A15) — a genuinely orthogonal 5th mechanism. Boundary asym (1.52) with the safety edge risk-off-concentrated (asym 1.55 off vs 1.34 on): the weakest-safety member, watch under costs.

signals.name: tier-M oil-relief rotation into oversold RS-laggards
signals.mechanism: Tier-M (354 subsector/theme nodes) oil-relief rotation: a subsector with sustained oil-cost relief (oil_ret_10d<0), oversold oscillator (stochrsi_w_k<30), AND still lagging the market on relative strength (rs<-0.04) — the RS-lag selects catch-up laggards that underperformed during the oil-high regime and are bottoming as oil eases. Genuinely rotational: median 2 nodes/date across 143 distinct holdout dates (not cross-sectional replication). Oil leg is load-bearing (baseline without oil fails the WR gate). Same oil-relief mechanism as tier-S R4_E10 at finer resolution. Caveat: tier-M 2021-2026 era + survivorship inflate magnitudes; haircut before live weight.
signals.cluster: tier-m-oil (siblings M1_OIL_DOWN_WASHOUT n=38k, M1_OIL_CROSS_K25 — validated+attributed, not separately published; 62-72% overlap)

signals.name: single-regime: bear-tape V-bottom rotation (tier-M)
signals.mechanism: SINGLE-REGIME (Amendment 1) tier-M defensive rotation: in a BEAR TAPE (spy_above_200d==0), buy a subsector whose acceleration is repairing from a moderate extreme (accel_z crossed_above -1.5) while deeply oversold (stochrsi_w_k<20). Validates the operator's core thesis — rotating into oversold accel-repair names DURING a downtape is drawdown-safe (asym 1.86) and high-WR (.80 OOS). ATTRIBUTION: the bear-tape gate is load-bearing — plain V-bottom (both regimes) FAILS the WR gate at 0.617; confining to the bear tape lifts WR to 0.679, asym 1.75->1.86 (the deepest downtape washouts carry the most reversion). Evaluated on the single-regime path: Leg 4' (risk-off only, n=1403) + REGIME-MATCHED placebo (beats random within-bear-tape timing, 5.57%>3.18%). CAVEAT: OOS rests on 23 distinct risk-off dates (~11 nodes/date) in the 2021-2026 survivorship-y era; haircut before live weight.

signals.name: oversold relative-laggard reversion (tier-M, dual-regime)
signals.mechanism: tier-M dual-regime oversold relative-laggard reversion: buy a subsector that is BOTH a relative underperformer (rs<-0.04, lagging the cross-section) AND deeply oversold (stochrsi_w_k<20). Works equally in risk-on and risk-off (WR .625 vs .626) — a genuine DUAL-regime mechanism (the bear-tape confinement tested in SR-M1 was decorative; the pure laggard passes the standard gate). Genuinely rotational: median 2 nodes/date across 210 distinct holdout dates. Forms an rs-laggard cluster with M1_OIL_DOWN_K30_RS_NEG (48% overlap; this is the purer, oil-free, deeper-oversold member). CAVEAT: tier-M 2021-2026 era + survivorship inflate magnitudes (asym 2.74, ret +9.79%); OOS 2024+ holds and placebo clears wide; haircut before live weight.
signals.cluster: rs-laggard {this, M1_OIL_DOWN_K30_RS_NEG} — 48% entry-overlap (shared rs<-0.04 core); ~1.5 independent bets. This is the purer, oil-free, deeper-oversold member.

signals.name: Rate relief then sector washout
signals.mechanism: Rates rally first (tlt_ret_10d crosses above 0), THEN a sector weekly washout appears within 10 sessions: buys rate-sensitive capitulations after the rate headwind has already relented. Sequence-native (grammar v1.2.0) — the causal ordering is the mechanism; the simultaneous-AND form is a different, weaker signal.
